primary.title: Raja Venkatraman, MarketSmith recommend five stocks for 29 May
primary.summary: Indian markets faced a second day of losses on 27 May, with the BSE Sensex down 141.90 points amid cautious investor sentiment and foreign fund outflows. The NSE Nifty 50 also fell slightly, while broader market performance presented mixed results as markets prepared to close for Bakri Id.
